clips.title: The story
paras: In Orgrimmar, Grunth eagerly seeks the company of Horde champions. The young orc lives in the Drag orphanage and, during Children's Week, journeys across Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms to learn what it means to be a hero.

Grunth is a young orc orphan in the Drag of Orgrimmar, where Orphan Matron Battlewail cares for him. Raised in Durotar's harsh red wastes, he watches armored adventurers with awe and asks them questions without end. Are armored warriors truly terrifying? Why does lightning on water not kill every fish? Will he ever see someone fight an actual dragon?

During Children's Week, an Orcish Orphan Whistle summons Grunth to travel with adventurers on a tour across the world. He wants to meet High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof in Mulgore, see the ruined throne room of Lordaeron, and visit the rugged frontiers where his people fight for their future.
